result.brief: 提出分层课程迁移学习框架，将手术流程分解为阶段-任务-动作三级，渐进微调预训练文生视频扩散模型，并配合动态采样处理变分辨率变长片段，在甲状腺切除术数据上降低FVD/FID。
result.reason: Adapts pretrained text-to-video diffusion via hierarchical curriculum for surgical video generation, with FVD/FID gains and dynamic sampling for variable-resolution clips; directly a video generation contribution.
